description: This file contains extension methods for reading variable-width encoded integers (varints) from a data source, specifically tailored for use with Orleans serialization framework. It provides methods to read signed and unsigned integers of various sizes with different wire types, along with zig-zag decoding for signed integers.

classes.name: VarIntReaderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to read variable-width integers (varints) with support for different wire types and zig-zag decoding for signed integers.

methods.name: ReadVarInt8
methods.description: Reads a variable-width signed 8-bit integer (sbyte) using zig-zag decoding.

methods.name: ReadVarInt16
methods.description: Reads a variable-width signed 16-bit integer (short) using zig-zag decoding.

methods.name: ReadVarInt32
methods.description: Reads a variable-width signed 32-bit integer (int) using zig-zag decoding.

methods.name: ReadVarInt64
methods.description: Reads a variable-width signed 64-bit integer (long) using zig-zag decoding.

methods.name: ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads a byte from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a ushort from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a uint from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a ulong from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt8
methods.description: Reads an sbyte from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt16
methods.description: Reads a short from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads an int from the reader with specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a long from the reader with specified wire type.
